decisions.reason: The combined shuttering/de-shuttering robot is a flagship of the firm's publicly announced automation strategy with heavy sunk R&D, so management will attribute weak demand to the temporary construction slump and persist.

The de-shuttering robot is an integral module of automated circulation plants, and its visible market presence and engineering investment favor keeping it, though some overlap with the combined robot makes it slightly more exposed.
The profile storage robot completes integrated shuttering lines, and management will treat slow sales as cyclical timing rather than a reason to withdraw it.
The automatic shuttering robot is central to the future-ready precast automation narrative and long customer investment cycles, so commitment remains strong.
The recently launched multi-model magazining, cleaning and plotting line represents substantial fresh investment and public commitment, so it is far too early to abandon it.
The production analysis software supports the firm's digitalization and lifecycle-service direction at low ongoing cost, so management will keep developing it.
